entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Also heard Ms. A. Begum, learned Addl. PP for the State.

Page No.# 2/2 This criminal petition is filed by the petitioner praying for quashing of the PRC Case No. 499/2018 arising out of G.R. Case No. 540/2018 as well as the order dated 24.07.2019 passed by the CJM, Tinsukia taking cognizance of the offences under Sections 120B/420/468 of the IPC.
Let Notice be issued, Returnable in four week.
Since Ms. A. Begum, learned Addl. PP appears for the State, Notices are waived.
However, extra copies be furnished within one week from today.
Steps on respondent No. 2 be taken by registered post with A/D Card.
Since the interim order has been passed in similar matter being Crl. Pet No. 1211/2022, this Court is of the view that the benefit of interim protection should also be granted to the petitioner.
Accordingly, the proceeding in PRC Case No. 499/2018 pending before the Court of CJM, Tinsukia arising out of GR Case No. 540/2018 will remain stayed till the next returnable date.
